scope: Primary measurements and authoritative formula documentation used by environment.py. None is a lunar floater observation.

sources.citation: Wang S, Hoch G, Grun G, Kahmen A (2024). Water loss after stomatal closure: quantifying leaf minimum conductance and minimal water use in nine temperate European tree species during a severe drought. Tree Physiology44, tpae027.
sources.access: Full-text methods, Table1 and abstract read.
sources.use: Observed0.8–4.8mmol/m²/s minimum conductance was measured at20°C,69%RH on TOTAL TWO-SIDED area; double to1.6–9.6mmol/m²/s for this model's one-sided leaf area. Measurements bracket residual-permeability sensitivities only.
sources.limit: Detached terrestrial tree leaves, active air circulation, not aerial plants. Temperature acclimation and continuous lunar-cycle survival unmeasured. Night conductance need not equal fully closed minimum.

sources.citation: Gauthier PPG et al. (2018). Measurement of Gross Photosynthesis, Respiration in the Light, and Mesophyll Conductance Using H2 18O Labeling. Plant Physiology177,62–74.
sources.access: Publisher full text and stomatal-conductance results inspected.
sources.use: Measured light response reached approximately0.1mol/m²/s under the experiment's conditions; informs scale of active-conductance sensitivity.
sources.limit: One experimental system, not a universal stomatal parameter or a value validated at altitude.

sources.citation: Ritter A et al. (2008). Fog Water Collection in a Subtropical Elfin Laurel Forest of the Garajonay National Park (Canary Islands): A Combined Approach Using Artificial Fog Catchers and a Physically Based Impaction Model. Journal of Hydrometeorology9,920–935.
sources.access: Publisher indexed abstract and results excerpts read; direct full-text retrieval returned403.
sources.use: Two-year field catcher data combined with an impaction model establish context for fog collection. Reported calculated LWC commonly below0.1g/m³, with some0.1–0.2g/m³;0.05/0.1/0.5g/m³ here are sensitivities, the largest an explicit extension.
sources.limit: Tree capture was modeled from measurements; it is not a direct free-drifting biological collector efficiency. Lunar LWC and encounter duty unavailable.

sources.citation: Vömel H (2025). Water Vapor Pressure Formulations. NSF NCAR Earth Observing Laboratory.
sources.use: Documents updated Buck1996 liquid-water saturation equation; pressure-enhancement factor omitted in screening.
sources.limit: Below freezing describes supercooled liquid equilibrium, not organism freeze tolerance.

sources.citation: Genotypic variation in transpiration efficiency due to differences in photosynthetic capacity among sugarcane-related clones (2017).
sources.access: Primary article indexed equations2 and following diffusion-ratio passage inspected.
sources.use: A=g_CO2(Ca−Ci); g_water=1.6g_CO2. Used only for the standard diffusion algebra, with Ci/Ca=.7 independently imposed as the inherited C3 scenario.
sources.limit: Sugarcane trait values are not transferred to the floater. Carbon pathways and boundary-layer resistance require separate treatment.
